Physical activity recommendations for adults

Recommendations

Adults should do at least 150 to 300 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic physical activity per week, or at least 75 to 150 minutes of vigorous-intensity aerobic physical activity per week.

Doing some physical activity is better than doing none, and adults should limit the amount of time spent being sedentary.

Cancer prevention

Regular physical activity reduces the risk of colon cancer and breast cancer and contributes to maintaining a healthy body weight.
